incidents.cause: A parallel spawn command returned a thread-limit error after one subagent had already started. A later explicitly recorded assignment repeated the two calls.
incidents.evidenceHandling: The second assignment overwrote the first raw/telemetry pair before the duplicate was detected. The surviving raw responses remain unedited. Standard telemetry fields describe the surviving attempt; attempts/retries and explicit aggregateSearchesUsed/discardedAttemptSearchesUsed fields preserve both attempts. Actual experiment searches are 171, four above the standard evaluator total of 167.
incidents.decision: Do not collect Prague again and do not count either affected source slot as reusable. Prague must remain incomplete in the frozen canary result; this one-city orchestration incident is inside the preregistered 1/20 tolerance.
